minimum_independence_requirements: no direct supervision chain with package authors
no financial or reputational stake in a particular adjudication outcome
no hidden access to unblinded condition labels before authorized unblinding
disqualifiers: dataset curation by the same reviewer
decision_authority_boundaries: reviewers may assess admissibility and methodology
reviewers may not convert protocol readiness into final claims
reviewers may not issue human-equivalence or metaphysical verdicts
interpretation_boundary: Reviewer independence is a governance layer only. It does not generate results and does not authorize claims.
